answer: The comet report reveals the merge explicitly at each juniper. Each collapsed cluster gets one tide weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 204 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 146 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3270 identities would post 2170 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
